dec.n: Plaintiff M70/2011 v. Minister for Immigration (Malaysia arrangement)
dec.pe: Australia agreed to send 800 asylum seekers to Malaysia in exchange for refugees. The High Court said this was unlawful because Malaysia was not bound to protect them.
dec.pi: Australia sepakat mengirim 800 pencari suaka ke Malaysia sebagai tukar dengan pengungsi. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini tidak sah karena Malaysia tidak terikat untuk melindungi mereka.

dec.n: NZYQ v. Minister for Immigration (indefinite detention)
dec.pe: A stateless Rohingya man had been held for years because no country would take him. The High Court said this was unlawful, and more than 100 people were released.
dec.pi: Seorang pria Rohingya tanpa kewarganegaraan ditahan bertahun-tahun karena tidak ada negara yang mau menerimanya. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan ini tidak sah, dan lebih dari 100 orang dibebaskan.
